Oatmeal Raisin Cookies

Ingredients

Yield: 24 3-inch cookies

  • 1 ½ cups rolled oats (5 ounces)

  • 1 cup minus 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour (4 ½ ounces)

  • 1 teaspoon baking soda

  • ¾ teaspoon ground cinnamon

  • 1 teaspoon flaky sea salt, plus more for sprinkling

  • 1 cup unsalted butter (2 sticks)

  • 1 cup light brown sugar (7 ounces)

  • ½ cup plus 1 tablespoon granulated sugar (4 ounces)

  • 2 large eggs

  • 1 tablespoon vanilla extract

  • 1 ¼ pounds raisins or chopped dates

Preparation

  1. Step 1

    Whisk the oats, flour, baking soda, cinnamon and salt in a bowl.

  2. Step 2

    Beat the butter and sugars until creamy, about 3 minutes, then beat in the eggs one at a time and the vanilla.

  3. Step 3

    Stir in the dry mix and the raisins, cover and chill for at least 2 hours.

  4. Step 4

    Heat the oven to 350 degrees, scoop the dough onto lined sheets, sprinkle with salt and bake 12 to 14 minutes.
